strings.economics.title: Cost calculator
strings.economics.description: Scenario model only: enter your own rates. Zero means an explicit zero cost, not an unknown price. This does not define credits or charge customers. Target cost is 40% and the absolute ceiling is 50%.
strings.economics.no_variable_cost: No variable query cost; fixed costs still apply
strings.economics.margin_warning: Exceeds the 50% cost ceiling or the Free budget.
strings.channels.api_help: Each key can only chat with this assistant. Creating a key never grants document or administration access.
strings.channels.secret_once: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.
strings.channels.server_only: Use this key only on your server. Never embed it in a browser, mobile bundle or public widget.
strings.channels.limits: 20 messages per key per minute; 120 per assistant across external channels. Keys expire within 365 days. History supports four short pairs.
strings.channels.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select and copy the secret manually.
strings.channels.widget_help: Visitors can read answers and cited file names from this assistant’s bases. Enable only content you want to publish. Allowed sites are the websites where you embed the chat, for example https://www.customer.com: protocol, domain and optional port, without paths. Confirm each site with its check to activate public chat there; HTTPS is required except HTTP on localhost. This does not configure external API clients; they authenticate with an API key. Site restrictions apply to browser embedding, not non-browser access. Public sessions share usage limits and expire after 30 minutes; reload to renew.
strings.channels.widget_site_hint: Press the check to activate public chat on this site.
strings.channels.widget_save_error: The change could not be confirmed. The previous saved configuration remains active. Retry to confirm.
strings.channels.widget_origins: Allowed site origins for the widget
strings.channels.widget_error: Enter a valid HTTPS site without paths or wildcards (HTTP is allowed on localhost). Do not repeat a site; at most 20 active sites are allowed.
strings.channels.snippet: Paste this snippet into an allowed site. It contains no API key.
strings.usage.title: Usage and credits
strings.usage.simulation: Local simulation · no payments or commercial prices
strings.usage.unlimited_help: Unlimited continues after included credits run out; extra consumption increases this estimate.
strings.usage.sync_error: Some operations could not synchronize. Their reservations remain held; the background worker will retry.
strings.usage.plan_help: Changing this selection applies at the next monthly UTC cycle. It never resets current consumption.
strings.errors.usage_limit: This organization has insufficient available credits. Ask the Admin to review consumption and the cycle.
strings.errors.usage_unavailable: Usage accounting is unavailable. Try again later; no new AI work has been started.
strings.trash.title: Trash
strings.trash.move_help: This item becomes unavailable immediately. You can restore it for 30 days; afterward its files are permanently removed in the background.
strings.trash.bot_help: The assistant becomes unavailable and its API keys are revoked. Public embedding is disabled. Shared knowledge bases are kept. Restoring does not reactivate keys or publish the widget.
strings.trash.description: Items can be restored for 30 days. Files are permanently removed after that period.
strings.trash.base_help: Unlink a base from every assistant before moving it to trash. Links from assistants in trash also count. Documents in that base will be kept for the restoration period.
strings.errors.knowledge_base_linked: This base is still linked to an assistant. Unlink it before deleting.
strings.errors.document_duplicate: An identical document already exists in this base.
strings.auth.handle_help: Use up to 64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
strings.errors.invitation: Use a valid invitation for this email and choose a username.
strings.errors.password: Use at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number and a symbol.
strings.team.title: Manage team
strings.team.description: Invite an email address. The recipient chooses their own username and password; you assign their role.
strings.team.sent: Invitation queued. The recipient can finish registration from their email.
strings.knowledge.title: Knowledge bases
strings.knowledge.description: Organize the documents your assistants will use. Each base belongs to this organization.
strings.knowledge.name: Knowledge base name
strings.knowledge.empty_description: Group related documents in one place. You can connect this knowledge to your bots later.
strings.knowledge.file_help: PDF, PNG or JPEG · up to 10 MiB per file.
strings.knowledge.file_invalid: Choose a non-empty PDF, PNG or JPEG file of at most 10 MiB.
strings.knowledge.processing_help: Processing may take a few minutes. Keep this page open until it finishes.
strings.knowledge.upload_failed_help: The list has been checked again. Refresh it before uploading the same file again; processing may have completed.
strings.knowledge.no_documents: No documents in this base yet.
strings.knowledge.no_documents_description: Upload the first document to review its extracted information here.
strings.errors.processing: The processing engine is unavailable. Check that the local AI service and models are running.
strings.bots.title: Bots
strings.bots.description: Configure your assistants, connect their knowledge and choose who can use them.
strings.bots.name: Bot name
strings.bots.empty: Create your first assistant, then connect its knowledge and assign Viewers.
strings.bots.knowledge_help: Choose the bases this bot may consult. Save each section separately.
strings.bots.viewers_help: Only selected Viewers can use this bot. Uncheck everyone to revoke Viewer access. Organization Admins always have access.
strings.bots.no_viewers: No Viewer members in this organization yet.
strings.team.admin_warning: An Admin can manage all members, bots and documents in this organization.
strings.team.viewer_warning: This user will only be able to use bots explicitly assigned to them.
strings.team.remove_warning: This removes organization access and bot assignments. Their account remains available for other organizations.
strings.errors.last_admin: The organization must keep at least one Admin.
strings.bots.logo_help: PNG only · up to 1 MiB · maximum 1024 × 1024 pixels.
strings.bots.logo_invalid: Choose a PNG logo of up to 1 MiB and 1024 × 1024 pixels.
strings.auth.invitation_description: Activate your access or request a new confirmation email.
strings.assistant.label: Document assistant
strings.assistant.create_description: Give your team a place to find answers in your documents.
strings.assistant.empty_description: Create an assistant, connect its knowledge and choose who can use it.
strings.assistant.configure_hint: Choose a tab to configure this assistant.
strings.assistant.create_help: Give it a name and a welcome message. Add knowledge and access from its card.
strings.assistant.knowledge_help: Link entire knowledge bases to reuse their documents without duplicating them.
strings.assistant.select_knowledge: Create or link a knowledge base to add documents here.
strings.access.empty: No emails have been assigned to this assistant.
strings.access.all_current: Give access to all current assistants
strings.access.scope_help: Applies to assistants that exist now. New assistants will not inherit this access.
strings.access.pending_help: A new email receives an invitation. Access stays pending until the recipient registers or accepts with their own account and verifies their email.
strings.access.pending_saved: Access pending. Invitation queued or already active.
strings.knowledge.drop_hint: Drop documents here or click to choose files.
strings.knowledge.too_many: Choose up to 10 files at a time.
strings.errors.admin_access: This email belongs to an Admin who already has access.
strings.sync.name_required: Enter an assistant name to sync your changes.
strings.sync.recovery: Your changes are still here. Retry, correct the fields, or discard pending changes to continue.
strings.api.description: This tab will manage this assistant’s external integration. API keys and permissions are not enabled yet.
strings.knowledge.unlink_help: Files and bases are preserved. Other assistants keep their links.
strings.session.title: Welcome back.
strings.session.description: Sign in again to access your assistants.
strings.knowledge.received: “{name}” was received. Processing continues in the background.
strings.knowledge.invalid_document: The file could not be read. Check its format or whether it is password protected.
strings.knowledge.processing_failed: Processing could not be completed. You can retry using the stored file.
strings.auth.onboard_description: Create your account and workspace. You will manage your own business as Admin after verifying your email. No invitation needed.
strings.onboarding.separate_business: This creates a separate workspace where you will be Admin. It does not change your access to other businesses.
strings.onboarding.confirmed: Email confirmed. Sign in to continue.
strings.onboarding.confirmation_failed: This confirmation link could not be verified. Request a new confirmation email.
strings.errors.account_exists: You already have an account. Sign in to continue; you can create another business from Account.
strings.chat.no_sources: No relevant information was found in this assistant’s knowledge bases.
strings.connections.title: Data connections
strings.connections.intro: Configure product, price and stock sources. No data has been synchronized yet.
strings.connections.name: Connection name
strings.connections.freshness_help: These limits determine when a price or stock value must no longer be treated as current. Saving them does not verify the provider connection.
strings.connections.origin_setup: Provider domains must be enabled before configuring queries. Receiving updates can be configured separately.
strings.connections.pull_help: Enter the key issued by the source system for read-only queries. The secret must contain 64 hexadecimal characters.
strings.connections.pull_saved: Provider key saved. If replacing a key, revoke the previous one at the provider when appropriate.
strings.connections.secret_once: Save this secret now. It will not be shown again. Keep it in the source system, never in public code.
strings.connections.rotate_help: The previous key will stop working in DocParse. Update the source system with the new key.
strings.connections.disconnect_help: This disables the connection and its stored keys in DocParse. To use the source again, create a new connection.
strings.connections.empty: No data connections have been configured.
strings.connections.secret_not_repeated: The connection already exists. Its original secret is not shown again; replace the receiving key if you did not save it.
strings.errors.connection_origin: This provider domain is not enabled. Request approval for the domain before configuring queries.
strings.errors.connection_conflict: The connection changed or the request was already used with different settings. Refresh the list before trying again.
